description: Kliment Yefremovich Voroshilov (Russian: Климент Ефремович Ворошилов ), popularly known as Klim Voroshilov (Russian: Клим Ворошилов; 4 February 1881 – 2 December 1969), was a prominent Soviet military officer and politician during the Stalin era (1924–1953).
